standard.summary: DreamBooth 用少量图片（5-20 张）训练模型学习新概念。instance_prompt 是触发词（如 'sks person'），class_prompt 是类别描述（如 'a person'）。prior_loss_weight 控制先验保留强度。
standard.effect: 模型学会将触发词与特定主体关联。class_prompt 帮助模型保持类别的泛化能力（先验保留）。
standard.whenToUse: 想用极少图片训练特定人物/物体/风格时。与 LoRA 结合可减少过拟合。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要泛化能力很强的大规模训练时。DreamBooth 更适合定制化而非泛化。

standard_en.summary: DreamBooth teaches a model a new concept from a handful of images (5-20). instance_prompt is the trigger ('sks person'), class_prompt the class description ('a person'), and prior_loss_weight sets how strongly the prior is preserved.
standard_en.effect: The model learns to tie the trigger to a particular subject. class_prompt helps it keep the class's generalisation (prior preservation).
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want to train a specific person, object or style from very few images. Combined with LoRA it also reduces overfitting.
standard_en.avoidWhen: For large-scale training that needs strong generalisation -- DreamBooth suits customisation rather than generalisation.

advanced.principle: DreamBooth 同时优化两个目标：(1) 重建目标（instance loss）——让模型从 instance_prompt 生成训练图片中的主体；(2) 先验保留（prior loss）——让模型对 class_prompt 的生成保持与预训练模型一致。num_class_images 控制生成的先验图片数量。use_lora=True 时用 LoRA 替代全参微调，减少过拟合。
advanced.intervention: training_loop 交替计算 instance loss 和 prior loss，按 prior_loss_weight 加权。
advanced.expectedImpact: 5-20 张图片即可实现高质量个性化生成。
advanced.tradeoffs: prior_loss_weight 太大会限制个性化程度；太小会导致类别概念被破坏。

advanced_en.principle: DreamBooth optimizes two objectives at once: (1) reconstruction (instance loss) — generate the subject in the training images from instance_prompt; (2) prior preservation (prior loss) — keep generation for class_prompt consistent with the pretrained model. num_class_images controls how many prior images are generated. use_lora=True uses LoRA instead of full fine-tuning, reducing overfitting.
advanced_en.intervention: training_loop alternates instance loss and prior loss, weighted by prior_loss_weight.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: High-quality personalized generation from just 5-20 images.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: prior_loss_weight too large limits personalization; too small lets the class concept erode.
